description_zh: 布琼巴托尔·甘布图杰（1900-1960）是蒙古人民党领导人。他领导蒙古实现了工业化发展，特别是戈壁地区的开发。他推动了蒙古工业化的进程，奠定了国家工业化基础。
description_en: Büjin Byambatsogt Sukhbaatar (1900-1960) was leader of Mongolian People Party. Led Mongolia through industrialization development, particularly Gobi Desert region development. Promoted Mongolian industrialization process, laid foundation for national industrial base.
reason_zh: 苏赫巴托尔的治理智慧体现在党领导和工业发展中。通过戈壁地区开发实现了蒙古工业化。他的党领导实现了蒙古的稳定和发展。
reason_en: Sukhbaatar's governance wisdom exemplified in party leadership and industrial development. Through Gobi Desert development, achieved Mongolian industrialization. Party leadership realized Mongolian stability and development.
